newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end off two pct on Iraq crisis news.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end off two pct on Iraq crisis news.

text.p: Thai stocks, which fell sharply after the noon break on Tuesday on news the United States had launched missiles on Iraq, rebounded to end down 2.01 percent after late buying in all sectors, brokers said.
The index dropped 48.45 points to hit an intraday low of 1,037.78 points five minutes after the market opened in the afternoon.
The index later steadied after investors bought stocks across the board, especially in blue-chip shares, brokers said.

"There was a panic selling across the board especially by local investors after they heard the news about the U.S. launching cruise missile attacks on Iraq," said Virat Tippanonthakul of First Asia Securities.
U.S. officials have said the attack on Iraqi targets was in retaliation for Baghdad's move against Kurds in the north.
"The index is expected to move sideways on Wednesday because it has already fallen heavily today," Virat said.
